title: NECO Civic Education Part 2: Social Vices, National Development & Governance - Civic Education - Political Apathy
exam: NECO Civic Education Part 2: Social Vices, National Development & Governance
subject: Civic Education

questions.q: The complete lack of interest, enthusiasm, and participation by citizens in the political and electoral activities of their country is referred to as...
options: political socialization.
political apathy.
disenfranchisement.
political gerrymandering.
questions.explain: **Political apathy** is the indifference and lack of interest displayed by citizens toward political processes, such as refusing to register to vote, boycotting elections, or ignoring political debates.
questions.exam: NECO Civic Education Part 2: Social Vices, National Development & Governance
questions.subject: Civic Education

questions.q: Which of the following is a major factor that causes political apathy among the electorate in developing democracies?
options: Transparent and highly credible electoral processes
Repeated unfulfilled campaign promises by politicians
High level of civic education in rural communities
Strict adherence to the constitutional rule of law
questions.explain: When politicians consistently fail to deliver on their campaign promises (the dividends of democracy), citizens lose trust in the government. This **loss of trust and political deception** directly breeds political apathy.
questions.exam: NECO Civic Education Part 2: Social Vices, National Development & Governance
questions.subject: Civic Education

questions.q: When citizens repeatedly witness electoral violence, ballot box snatching, and election rigging, they are most likely to react by...
options: voluntarily donating private funds to political campaigns.
becoming indifferent and withdrawing from future electoral processes.
joining the national armed forces in large numbers.
demanding an immediate return to colonial administration.
questions.explain: Electoral violence, thuggery, and rigging create a fearful and unfair environment. As a result, ordinary citizens **withdraw from the political process (apathy)** to ensure their personal safety and because they feel their votes will not count.
questions.exam: NECO Civic Education Part 2: Social Vices, National Development & Governance
questions.subject: Civic Education

questions.q: A major negative consequence of widespread political apathy in a democratic society is that it leads to...
options: the emergence of unaccountable and incompetent leaders.
a rapid increase in foreign direct investment.
the strict protection of fundamental human rights.
a highly equitable distribution of national resources.
questions.explain: When the majority of decent citizens refuse to vote or participate in politics, a minority decides the outcome. This usually results in the **election of corrupt, self-centered, and incompetent leaders** who are not accountable to the general public.
questions.exam: NECO Civic Education Part 2: Social Vices, National Development & Governance
questions.subject: Civic Education

questions.q: Elected political leaders often fail to protect the interests and welfare of their followers primarily due to...
options: the strict separation of powers entrenched in the constitution.
selfishness, greed, and widespread corruption in public office.
excessive participation of citizens in town hall meetings.
the overabundance of natural resources in the nation.
questions.explain: Many leaders fail their constituents because they prioritize their personal enrichment over public welfare. **Greed, selfishness, corruption, and a lack of patriotic vision** are the root causes of leadership failure.
questions.exam: NECO Civic Education Part 2: Social Vices, National Development & Governance
questions.subject: Civic Education

questions.q: Political leaders can successfully protect the interests of their followers and rebuild public trust by...
options: delivering the dividends of democracy through good governance and accountability.
censoring the mass media to eliminate public criticism of their policies.
increasing the financial cost of purchasing party nomination forms.
appointing exclusively family members into key administrative public offices.
questions.explain: Leaders protect citizens' interests by practicing **good governance, ensuring transparency, executing people-oriented projects (dividends of democracy), and upholding the rule of law**, which collectively improve the citizens' standard of living.
questions.exam: NECO Civic Education Part 2: Social Vices, National Development & Governance
questions.subject: Civic Education

questions.q: Which of the following is a proactive strategy that civil society and the government can use to discourage political apathy among youths?
options: Banning independent international electoral observers during voting
Educating citizens extensively on their political rights and the importance of voting
Deploying heavily armed military personnel to intimidate voters at polling units
Restricting the citing of all polling stations strictly to urban government centers
questions.explain: Ignorance fuels apathy. **Civic education and political enlightenment** empower citizens, helping them understand that their vote is their voice and power, which in turn encourages active political participation.
questions.exam: NECO Civic Education Part 2: Social Vices, National Development & Governance
questions.subject: Civic Education

questions.q: The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) can significantly reduce political apathy and encourage voter turnout by...
options: increasing the minimum voting age requirement to exclude youths.
announcing official election results weeks before the actual voting day.
ensuring that the entire electoral process is transparent, free, fair, and secure.
imposing heavy financial taxation on citizens who refuse to register.
questions.explain: When an electoral umpire conducts a **transparent, free, and fair election** without manipulation, it restores public confidence in the ballot system. Citizens will actively participate when they believe their votes will genuinely count.
